paragraphs.text: The Parliament sitting is scheduled from 30 November to 3 December 2026.
The Monsoon Session remained formally open for more than 100 days since both Houses were adjourned sine die on 13 August.

On Thursday, 26 November, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced on social media that the government is preparing to call a one-day special session of Parliament, and the Union government announced a four-day sitting of Parliament.

On Thursday, 26 November, Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju announced that the government (the BJP-led NDA government) requested the presiding officers of both Houses to reconvene their sittings, and the parliamentary affairs minister requested the Lok Sabha speaker and Rajya Sabha chairman to reconvene the Houses.
The Rajya Sabha is proposed to meet starting 2 December 2026, and the parliamentary session may conclude on 3 December 2026.
The special session is not part of the Winter Session.
The government intends to take up essential government business during the reconvened session.
"Sittings in both Houses could conclude on December 3, 2026," Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju said.
"Rijiju added that there will be no Question Hour, Zero Hour and Private Members' business during the sittings," Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs Kiren Rijiju said.

"The government requested the Lok Sabha to reconvene on Monday, 30 November 2026," and requested the Rajya Sabha to reconvene on Wednesday, 2 December 2026," Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiran Rijiju said.

paragraphs.text: The proposed amendment would raise the Lok Sabha's strength from 543 seats to a maximum of 850 through delimitation.
Parliamentary rules require the government to give three days' notice for a special session.
Passing a Constitutional Amendment Bill requires a special majority, defined as a majority of the total membership of the House and at least two-thirds of the members present and voting.
The Winter Session will be called.

other_coverage.text: In April, the BJP-led NDA government failed to secure the passage of a delimitation Bill.
The aim is to implement 33 per cent reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies ahead of the 2029 general election.
Southern states have raised concerns that delimitation could reduce their share of Lok Sabha seats.
The government is considering a formula to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 percent to address concerns of southern states.
The NDA currently has 320 members in the 543-member Lok Sabha.
The opposition is aggressive regarding the special revision of the voter list and the demand for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
The Congress-led Opposition argues that women's reservation should be implemented without linking it to delimitation.
Opposition parties accuse the Centre of attempting to redraw the electoral map to favour the ruling alliance.
The government's previous attempt to pass the women's reservation constitutional amendment failed in April because it did not secure a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha.
The NDA has 324 MPs in the Lok Sabha.
The proposed legislative package is expected to include a constitutional amendment to advance the implementation of the 33 per cent women's reservation law linked to a delimitation exercise.
A delimitation exercise could expand the strength of the Lok Sabha.

राज्यसभा के 2 दिसंबर 2026 से शुरू होने की बैठक प्रस्तावित है, और संसदीय सत्र 3 दिसंबर 2026 को समाप्त हो सकता है।

"दोनों सदनों में बैठकें 3 दिसंबर, 2026 को समाप्त हो सकती हैं," केंद्रीय संसदीय मामलों के मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने कहा।

संसदीय मामलों के मंत्री किरेन रिजिजू ने कहा, "सरकार ने लोकसभा से सोमवार, 30 नवंबर 2026 को फिर से बैठक करने का अनुरोध किया, और राज्यसभा से बुधवार, 2 दिसंबर 2026 को फिर से बैठक करने का अनुरोध किया।"
प्रस्तावित संशोधन परिसीमन के माध्यम से लोकसभा की संख्या 543 सीटों से बढ़ाकर अधिकतम 850 कर देगा।
संसदीय नियमों के अनुसार सरकार को विशेष सत्र के लिए तीन दिन का नोटिस देना आवश्यक है।

संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पारित करने के लिए विशेष बहुमत की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसे सदन की कुल सदस्यता के बहुमत और उपस्थित तथा मतदान करने वाले सदस्यों के कम से कम दो-तिहाई बहुमत के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है।
विंटर सत्र बुलाया जाएगा।

context.text: मानसून सत्र 13 अगस्त, 2026 को दोनों सदनों के अनिश्चितकाल के लिए स्थगित होने के बाद से 100 दिनों से अधिक समय से औपचारिक रूप से खुला है।
संसदीय नियमों के अनुसार सरकार को विशेष सत्र के लिए तीन दिन का नोटिस देना आवश्यक है।

संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पारित करने के लिए विशेष बहुमत की आवश्यकता होती है, जिसे सदन की कुल सदस्यता के बहुमत और उपस्थित तथा मतदान करने वाले सदस्यों के कम से कम दो-तिहाई बहुमत के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है।
विंटर सत्र बाद में बुलाया जाएगा।
